sections.label: Narrative
sections.content: Claude Code reported that agents cannot ask a repository for the latest or changed notes (no date sort, no changed-since filter, no created/updated times on notes). The owner then named it a critical issue for the top of the agent-assisted editor pipeline: in a conversation with several agents, each must see what has changed, and stay out of areas that are not the current focus; the attention PR (srs-rust#1472) is part of the same remedy (800f223f).
